bio.text: Tammy Duckworth was elected to the U.S. Senate from Illinois in 2016, after representing Illinois's 8th District in the U.S. House for two terms.

She served in the Reserve Forces for 23 years, retiring as a lieutenant colonel in 2014, and was deployed to Iraq in 2004 as a helicopter pilot with the Illinois Army National Guard; she is a Purple Heart recipient.
She was Director of the Illinois Department of Veterans' Affairs and, from 2009, an Assistant Secretary of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.
